title: AllSaints Crystal Front-to-Back Earrings, Crystal/Warm Silver

comparisons.notes: Same AllSaints Crystal Front to Back Earrings in Crystal/Warm Silver, item 9179538; photo matches the Woot image (silver tennis chain, front-to-back, hex post). Price and in-stock status read from Stylight's mirror of the listing.

writeup: These AllSaints front-to-back earrings pair a tennis-style rhinestone chain with a hexagonal post, made of brass with stainless steel posts, in the Crystal/Warm Silver color. Woot has them new for $13.99, while Nordstrom lists the same pair at $59. Quantity was very low when we spotted it.
amazon_match_notes: Matched by visual and spec match to model 597798SLV114, Crystal/Warm Silver.
